name: games
description: Browser games monorepo: a TypeScript Snake and a Next.js Tic-Tac-Toe with an unbeatable minimax AI. Ships to one Cloudflare Pages project.
author: Ali Ammari

scripts.build:snake: cd snake-game && bun install && bun run build
scripts.build:ttt: cd Tic-Tac-Toe-Game && bun install && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/ttt bun run build
scripts.build: bun run build:snake && bun run build:ttt && bun run assemble
scripts.test: cd snake-game && bun run test && cd ../Tic-Tac-Toe-Game && bun run test
